h1: Phuiyara Resort — a mountain-view resort with a pool near Khun Dan Dam, Nakhon Nayok
intro: If you want a mountain-view resort with a pool to splash in, an on-site cafe to relax at, and a base close to the nature spots around Khun Dan Dam, Phuiyara Resort is a place locals and Bangkok weekenders return to. It is a mid-sized resort in the Hin Tung area of Mueang Nakhon Nayok, known for its mountain views, open grounds and a good range of on-site activities — an outdoor pool, cafe, restaurant, karaoke and a BBQ area — plus bikes you can borrow to ride around. It is about a two-hour drive from Bangkok. Score 8.3 from 112 reviews. From approx. ฿1,500/night.

body.html: Phuiyara Resort sits in the Hin Tung area of Mueang Nakhon Nayok, on the side you drive up toward Khun Dan Prakan Chon Dam and Nang Rong Waterfall. It is a mid-sized resort built around families and groups of friends rather than a tiny boutique stay. What guests agree on is the space — plenty of trees and garden, a mountain ridge as the backdrop, and enough on-site activities to fill a whole day without driving anywhere.

Rooms come in several types, from mountain-view rooms and two-storey duplex rooms to a one-bedroom villa. The rooms people praise most are the ones that open onto the mountain and pool, with an airy feel. Most reviews say the rooms are decently sized with comfortable beds, air-con and a flat-screen TV, and some have a small kitchenette and fridge — handy for families or groups staying a few nights. The selling point here is the view and the space, not luxury finishes, but at this price it lands well.
"Great view, lovely atmosphere, a pool the kids could swim in, and the food at the resort was reasonably priced. The staff were friendly — a good family getaway."

What gives Phuiyara an edge over the smaller stays in the same area is the range of on-site activities. There is an outdoor pool to swim in, a cafe and restaurant on the grounds, karaoke rooms for groups who want to sing at night, a BBQ area for a small party, and bikes you can borrow to ride around the garden. There is also a massage service and a meeting room for seminar groups — which is why many groups pick this place, since everything is in one spot and you do not have to drive out to find something to do.

The location is in Hin Tung, the nature-facing side of Mueang Nakhon Nayok. It is close to Khun Dan Prakan Chon Dam, Nang Rong Waterfall and Wang Takrai Park, all about 10–15 minutes by car, and roughly two hours from Bangkok — a comfortable base for touring the waterfalls and nature spots on this side. The upside is that it sits closer to the main sights than many of the Pak Phli-side stays, though you still need your own car since the town shops are some way off.

To be straight with you, there are a few things worth knowing before booking. Some reviews flag that certain rooms smell a little musty, especially ones that have been closed up for a while, and that the parking entrance can be a bit of a walk from the rooms. A few guests mention hearing noise from neighbouring rooms or party groups, and some feel the price and in-room fittings are not quite balanced. This is honest feedback from real reviews, but the overall tone stays positive — especially on the view, the pool and the food. Combined scores sit around 7.7–8.3 across platforms, solid for a budget-friendly family resort.

Overall, Phuiyara Resort suits anyone after a mountain-view resort with a pool and built-in activities, at an easy price, close to the Khun Dan Dam side. If you are travelling as a family or a group of friends and want somewhere the kids can swim, a BBQ spot and karaoke, and a base near the waterfalls, it does that job well for the money. Just keep an open mind about the musty smell in some rooms and the noise on busy weekends, pick a mountain-view room, and you will get what you came for.

A tip from reading through the reviews: ask for a room facing the mountain and away from the party/karaoke zone if you want a quiet stay. If you are sensitive to musty smells, request a room that has been recently used and air it out with the air-con before settling in. Come from late rainy season into early winter (Sep–Dec) when Nang Rong Waterfall is full, the air is cool and the mountain views are clear — and do not miss an evening swim when the light softens and the mountain looks its best.

honestSummary: Phuiyara Resort is a strong pick for anyone wanting a mountain-view resort with a pool and built-in activities, at an easy price, near the Khun Dan Dam side. Its strengths are the view, the pool, the food and plenty to do — good for families and groups. Just keep an open mind about musty smells in some rooms, noise on busy weekends, and rooms that are fairly basic on finish.
honestChecks: If you are sensitive to musty smells and fussy about room finish — reviews note some rooms smell musty, especially long-closed ones → ask for a recently used room, air it out with the air-con first, and treat this as a family mountain-view resort, not a luxury stay.

If you want a quiet stay and dislike noise — there are karaoke rooms and a BBQ area, and party groups show up on weekends → request a room away from the activity zone and facing the mountain for a much quieter night.
If you come on a long weekend or in waterfall season — the Khun Dan Dam / Nang Rong side is popular, rooms fill fast and prices climb → book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate first.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Phuiyara Resort Nakhon Nayok

faq.q: Where is Phuiyara Resort and what is nearby?
faq.a: Phuiyara Resort is at 99/1 Moo 2, Hin Tung, Mueang Nakhon Nayok, on the side near Khun Dan Prakan Chon Dam. It is about 10–15 minutes from Khun Dan Dam, Nang Rong Waterfall and Wang Takrai Park, and roughly 20–25 minutes from Sarika Waterfall and Nakhon Nayok town. It is about a two-hour drive from Bangkok, making a handy base for the waterfalls on this side.

faq.q: How much does Phuiyara Resort cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿1,500/night for a Superior mountain-view room. There are also vintage-style rooms, two-storey duplex rooms, and a one-bedroom villa with a small kitchenette for families/groups, going up to around ฿3,200. Prices shift with the season and holidays, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What pool and activities does Phuiyara Resort have?
faq.a: It has an outdoor swimming pool, cafe, restaurant, karaoke rooms, a BBQ area and bikes to borrow. There is also a massage service and a meeting room for seminar groups. It suits families and groups who want plenty to do on-site without driving out anywhere.

faq.q: Are the musty-smell and noise issues at Phuiyara Resort real?
faq.a: Some reviews do flag that certain rooms smell musty, especially long-closed ones, and that you can hear noise from neighbouring rooms or weekend party groups. If that matters to you, ask for a recently used room, air it out with the air-con before settling in, and pick a room away from the karaoke/BBQ zone.

faq.q: Is Phuiyara Resort good for families and groups?
faq.a: Yes. It has a pool the kids can swim in, duplex rooms and a villa for groups, plus a BBQ area and karaoke. With open grounds, mountain views and the waterfalls nearby, it works well for families or groups of friends after a relaxed, budget-friendly stay with things to do.
